Ravi K.: Heads-up, I ran into an edge where strict rollout schema validation blocked a legacy job. We need a safer migration path than a full-enforce flip.
Elena V.: Agreed. My proposal: add a thin control-plane adapter layer that can map a subset of v2 semantics into v1-compatible fields at read-time. No forced backfill.
Tom S.: Can you give an example of mapping?
Elena V.: e.g., new `placement.hint` -> translate to `affinity` tag when present, but only if runtime advertises `auto_map_v2`. Otherwise leave `meta.v2` untouched.
Priya N.: I like the adapter idea. Also add explicit validation modes: `permissive` (ignore unknown), `warn` (metric + warning), `strict` (reject). Teams can opt into strict after canary.
Ravi K.: How do runtimes declare they understand v2 semantics vs relying on adapter?
Tom S.: Capability handshake via manifest and runtime header. Example: manifest contains `capabilities: [\"schema:v2\", \"placement_v2\"]`. Runtime exposes `X-Runtime-Capabilities: schema:v2;placement_v2`. Control-plane and SDKs read those.
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: rolling canary started for adapter service (canary_id: adp-2026-07). 3/10 pods healthy.
Priya N.: For routing, avoid surprises: only use true v2-only routing decisions when target node explicitly has `placement_v2`. Otherwise the adapter returns a v1-safe plan.
Elena V.: Also propose a "shadow evaluation" feature: evaluate rollout decisions with v2 rules in shadow against live traffic but don't act on them. Collect diffs and false-positive rates.
Ravi K.: Nice. That will surface mismatches before enforcement.
Tom S.: Telemetry keys we should add: `schema_adapter_mapped`, `schema_diff_rate`, `schema_rejects_strict`, `shadow_mismatch_pct`.
Priya N.: Migration path: start with permissive + shadow for 2 weeks, then warn mode for another week, then allow owners to flip strict after addressing diffs. Document migration checklist in RFC.
Elena V.: For persisted exports/imports: always include a `serialized_v2` blob in the export, plus top-level v1 fields. Importers that can parse v2 should prefer it. Keeps portability.
Ravi K.: Example payload pattern I suggested:```
{
  "pin_id": "pin-42",
  "version": "v3-alpha",
  "placement": "legacy-affinity",
  "meta.v2": {
    "placement": {"node_class": "gpu.large", "priority": 10},
    "annotations": {"cost_hint": "low"},
    "schema_version": "2"
  },
  "serialized_v2": "<base64>..."
}
```
Tom S.: Good. One safety rule: no unknown v2 key may change placement or cost without an explicit capability bit. Adapter can map but only if `placement_v2` capability exists in manifest.
Priya N.: Testing: create synthetic workloads that trigger placement differences and run shadow evaluation for at least 100k requests per canary to measure impact. Add SDK parser warnings when encountering `meta.v2` in `warn` mode.
Elena V.: I'll draft the RFC with: adapter spec, handshake headers, validation modes, shadowing plan, telemetry names, and export format. Will include sample adapter mapping table.
Ravi K.: Thanks, please cc infra and SDK owners.
ops-bot: Note: adapter canary health: 7/10 ready after restart.
Priya N.: I'll own the canary test harness and dashboards. Thanks all.
